notes: A centered white card with a large red Adobe logo tile says 'Grant Access' and that 'Application' is requesting access to your Adobe account. It lists four permissions with emoji icons: basic profile, email address, Adobe organization data, and read and analyze Adobe Experience Platform data. Cancel and Allow Access buttons sit side by side with a short agreement line below. The requesting app is only called the generic 'Application', not MCP Consents, and there is no sign-in form on this screen.
